content.short: aelf is an AI-enhanced, modular Layer 1 blockchain featuring a unique multi-sidechain architecture for high scalability.
content.description: aelf is a high-performance, AI-enhanced Layer 1 blockchain designed to support enterprise-grade decentralized applications. It utilizes a unique "Mainchain + multi-Sidechain" structure that enables parallel processing and unlimited scalability, targeting transaction speeds of over 35,000 TPS. Built with C# to ensure developer accessibility, aelf provides a modular framework that allows for customized sidechains tailored to specific business needs. The network is secured by a Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) consensus mechanism and is powered by the ELF token, aiming to become a cornerstone for the next generation of decentralized digital economies.
content.meta: aelf provides a modular, AI-integrated Layer 1 blockchain solution for enterprise scalability. Discover aelf on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
